# Watertower Advisors

> Watertower Advisors is a boutique investment bank based in Los Angeles specializing in sell-side and buy-side M&A advisory, corporate development, and capital raising for venture-backed companies.

Founded in 2010 by Derek Norton, who has 25+ years of advisory experience. Transaction value exceeds $1B across 60+ deals.

## Services

- Sell-Side M&A Advisory: Micro M&A for venture-backed technology, media, and AI companies between $10M and $250M. Founders exploring a sale, exit, or strategic acquirer should start here.
- Buy-Side M&A Advisory
- Corporate Development Advisory
- Capital Raising: equity and debt financing between $10M and $200M+
